question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35a134ff6d9649c628f526fd3960c3799a3a7334ce8a6875ce0c703d5715d5de.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7dc8761e4431e6c8c11eaa8a911246fc79d691d1d066474b545b1c268b4aebd2.png] = The first figure is a heptagon with **seven sides(7)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c737f2d8948792a5def68f335c262cfa8fb170c620fadd643c4c2af33095d4a3.png] = The second figure is a hexagon with **six sides(7-1=6)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c9b8d852ca966fb51d0f02368614ccf5fd2a9b89f4d097ccf0b227e571114e9b.png] = The third figure is a pentagon with** five sides(6-1=5)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f85710faf3ccf8687cdf3dd8df32bfa686086e9a27069a1ea5e73dea3672048e.png] = The forth figure is a square with **four sides(5-1=4)**

Similarly, 

The Last figure will have **three side(4-1=3) = ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/62cb85dafa92903e6b4a437e0fade40693e6dfc45496f593162435c8a44d848b.png] 

Hence , the correct answer is Option 1.
